notes.title: Update 1.0.2 Released
notes.notes:
This update adds some minor features and Quality of Life improvements.

Changelog
- Allow multiple selections for booking filters.
- Indicate already booked feuds.
- Add pronouns to championships. This is used for the auto booker and simulator.
- Add 'Delete All' button to event card.
- Add 'Import Save' option under 'Continue' menu to allow importing save files. This can be used with 'Download Save' option under 'Options'.
- Show option to overwrite or create new save when importing a cloud save.
- Add 'Vacate' button for champions under roster overview.
- Enable remote play so you can use steam for screenshare in local multiplayer.
- And many minor visual improvements (highlight segment participants, add confirmation to TGI decline button, highlight fan change and more)

Fixes
- Fix: Couldn't fire retired staff members.
- Fix: Order of player names would be incorrect for local multiplayer games.
- Fix: Fix charisma/workrate sorting for drafts/trade page.

- Mahin

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 released
notes.notes:
Thank you so much to everyone who has bought the game! This update adds some Quality of Life improvements that have been suggested.

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
- Add filters and sort to Indies, Trade and Draft pages.
- Add search to Teams, Factions and Managers pages.
- Add search to feuds in the booking page.
- Add search when making selections for artifacts.
- Save settings (zoom, fullscreen/windowed) so they apply on reload.
- Add 'reset' option to settings page.
- Show 'Logged In' instead of display name in main menu.
- Add on/off toggle for music and sound effects in settings page.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
- Fix: 'Confirm' button wouldn't show up for buyouts if you ran more than one buyout.
- Fix: Available callup would show information of talent from another save.
- Fix: You could run out of creative points in sandbox mode.

- Mahin
